# ModelAtlas — The Open-Source AI Model Atlas

> llms.txt manifest (https://llmstxt.org). For AI crawlers and agents.
> Human-readable version: https://github.com/Amitmishra98/.p (README.md)
> Structured data: data/models.json · data/models.csv

ModelAtlas is a research-grade, living directory of open-weight and open-source AI: large language models, MoE, reasoning, coding, vision-language, image, video, audio/music, TTS, ASR, embedding, reranker, and 3D models — plus agents, frameworks, licenses, benchmarks, VRAM/hardware guides, and one-command local install instructions. Snapshot date: 2026-09-09. All benchmark figures are vendor-reported unless noted; verify on live leaderboards before production decisions.

## Key facts (Sept 2026)
- Best overall open frontier LLMs: DeepSeek V4-Pro-0813 (1.6T MoE/49B active, MIT, 1M context, open weights) and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B (2.4T MoE, custom license). 
- Best open coding/agentic models: Kimi K2.6 (1T MoE, Modified MIT, Apr 2026), GLM-5.2 (744B MoE, MIT, 1M ctx, Jun 2026), DeepSeek V4, Qwen3-Coder-Next.
- Best single-GPU models: Gemma 4 31B (Apache 2.0, ~18-22GB at Q4), Qwen3.8-27B (Apache 2.0), gpt-oss-120b/20b (Apache 2.0, OpenAI).
- Longest context: Llama 4 Scout 10M tokens (109B MoE). Others at 1M: DeepSeek V4, GLM-5.2, Qwen3.5/3.8, Kimi K2.6 (262K).
- Cleanest commercial licenses: Apache 2.0 (Qwen, Gemma 4, gpt-oss, Mistral, Wan, Z-Image, BGE) and MIT (DeepSeek, GLM, Phi, Kokoro, CosyVoice). Watch caps: Llama 4 (700M MAU), LTX (<$10M ARR), MiniMax H3 (<$20M), FLUX.2 dev, Hunyuan (100M MAU).
- Local install: `ollama pull <model>` (e.g., qwen3:8b, qwen3.8:27b, gemma4:e4b, gpt-oss:20b, phi4-mini, nomic-embed-text). VRAM ≈ params × bits / 8; Q4_K_M is the local default.
- Best open embeddings: Qwen3-Embedding-8B (~70.6 MTEB), BGE-M3 (MIT). Best open image: Qwen-Image-2512 (Apache 2.0). Best open video: Wan 2.2 (Apache 2.0). Best open TTS: Kokoro (82M, CPU) and Qwen3-TTS (3-second cloning, Apache 2.0). Best open 3D: Hunyuan3D 2.x and TRELLIS.2 (MIT).

## Caveats
- Snapshot dated 2026-09-09; model landscape changes monthly.
- Benchmarks are vendor-reported and not cross-harness comparable.
- "Open weights" ≠ "open source"; each model keeps its own license — read it.
- See README §24 for full disclaimer.
